meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude会作为协调者，把计划分成阶段，派遣子代理去执行实施、验证、检查反模式、审查代码质量等工作，自己只负责分配和确认，不亲自干活。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或实施一个计划时触发，尤其是make-plan创建的计划。

say.text: 请执行这个计划，按阶段推进。
say.note: Claude会派遣子代理逐阶段实施。

say.text: 运行make-plan生成的计划，完成后验证。
say.note: 每个阶段都会经过验证才提交。

say.text: 按计划实施，并在验证通过后再提交更改。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator, breaking the plan into phases and dispatching subagents for implementation, verification, anti-pattern checks, code quality review, and commits. It only coordinates and confirms, never doing the work itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute this plan, phase by phase.
say_en.note: Claude will dispatch subagents for each phase.

say_en.text: Run the plan from make-plan and verify when done.
say_en.note: Each phase is verified before moving on.

say_en.text: Implement per the plan, commit only after verification passes.
